rv.q: Richard Baron and Ellie Zeeghen’s Nan Shepherd: Naked and Unashamed is quite simply put, lovely.
Here, the human being behind the myth finds space to breathe and express herself.
Richard Baron and Ellie Zeeghen’s Nan Shepherd: Naked and Unashamed is quite simply lovely.

cn.t: Critics praise this "lovely" and "vivid, touching" exploration of Scottish nature writer Nan Shepherd's life, with the production earning strong reviews for its flowing storytelling and heartfelt portrayal of the posthumously celebrated author.
